description.value: Full-service campground tucked in the trees along the Coldwater River just south of Merritt, with flush washrooms, showers, laundry, and a convenience store; the final ½-mile approach is unpaved, and festival weekends bring large crowds with mandatory prepayment.

address.value: 1145 Neilson St, Merritt, BC V1K 1B8, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Moon Shadows is an active RV park and campground along the Coldwater River south of Merritt, BC. The homepage explicitly lists laundry, public restrooms with shower areas, and a convenience store among amenities. The reservations page confirms bookings by phone (250-315-2267) and email, and states the park is open year-round. Nearby dining is corroborated by a guest testimonial mentioning restaurants in Merritt and the recreation page listing dining as a nearby attraction. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, or charging facilities was found.
concerns: OSM name is 'Moon Shadows RV Park' but website consistently uses 'Moon Shadows RV Park and Campground'
No street address available in OSM or on the website; directions reference Neilson Street off Pooley Ave near Coldwater Road
Website copyright reads 2004; site content may be dated though the business appears operational
OSM has no phone; phone sourced from website only
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground near Merritt with tent sites, showers, laundry, and on-site convenience store, located along a major BC cycling corridor (Coquihalla/Hwy 97C). Suitable for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: laundry, public restrooms with shower areas, and a convenience store
